tools.name: validate_effect
tools.description: Check a complete proposed EffectDefinition using the actual kernel registration validator before returning an effect extension. Catches invalid ids, duplicate/invalid parameter keys, invalid pass counts, oversized shader bodies and invalid viewerHandles bindings. Declare viewerHandles (point, line, angle, radius, rect) on effect definitions for on-viewer parameter editing; line controls can bind a gradientStops parameter (2–16 normalized RGBA stops), available to GLSL as pm_<key>(t). See the effects authoring pack. Shader layers can declare d.viewerHandles bound to their annotated uniform keys. Compiles the GLSL shader for all passes and reports errors by line in frag. After loading, verify registration and render_frames output separately.

definition.description: The complete object passed to api.effects.register, including id, label, group, params and frag. Use an existing group (Blur & Sharpen, Light & Shadow, Color, Stylize, Distort, Generate) rather than inventing one.
